title: ReShap: Interpretable Reinforcement Learning for High-Dimensional Multi-Action Settings
abstract: arXiv:2611.15507v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deep Reinforcement Learning (RL) plays a crucial role in tackling complex tasks, yet its reliance on deep neural networks makes the learned policies opaque. To enhance the trustworthiness of RL policies, existing work (e.g., the SILVER framework [Li et al., 2025]) has focused on Shapley-based interpretability, but is typically restricted to low-dimensional state spaces, binary-action settings, and a single class of linear surrogate. We propose ReShap, a policy-distillation framework that extends Shapley-based interpretability to high-dimensional, multi-action environments. ReShap extracts compact feature representations from raw image observations, performs SHAP-based feature attribution to characterize how each feature contributes to the policy's decisions, and distills the deep RL policy into an interpretable surrogate trained on the full set of (state, policy-action) pairs along the policy's visited distribution. translated_title: ReShap：面向高维多动作环境的可解释强化学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.15507v1 公告类型：交叉。摘要：深度强化学习（RL）在应对复杂任务方面发挥着关键作用，但其对深度神经网络的依赖使得学习到的策略难以解释。为了增强强化学习策略的可信度，现有工作（例如 SILVER 框架 [Li et al., 2025]）聚焦于基于 Shapley 值的可解释性，但通常局限于低维状态空间、二元动作设置以及单一类别的线性代理模型。我们提出了 ReShap，这是一个策略蒸馏框架，将基于 Shapley 值的可解释性扩展到高维、多动作的环境。ReShap 从原始图像观测中提取紧凑的特征表示，进行基于 SHAP 的特征归因以刻画每个特征对策略决策的贡献，并将深度强化学习策略蒸馏为一个可解释的代理模型，该代理模型基于策略访问分布上的完整（状态，策略动作）对集合进行训练。我们实例化了（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: ReShap 是一个策略蒸馏框架，通过从原始图像中提取特征、执行 SHAP 特征归因，并将深度强化学习策略蒸馏为在完整状态-动作对上训练的可解释代理模型，从而将基于 Shapley 值的可解释强化学习扩展到了高维、多动作的环境。
en_tdlr: ReShap is a policy-distillation framework that extends Shapley-based interpretability to high-dimensional, multi-action RL environments by extracting compact features from raw image observations, performing SHAP-based feature attribution, and distilling the deep RL policy into an interpretable surrogate trained on the full set of visited state-action pairs.
